The following events took place in '''868 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*While still engulfed in an on-off civil war known as the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] becomes a member [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Naboo Republic date">In "[[Crisis on Naboo]]," an episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, it was stated that [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] "eight hundred and forty seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago." According to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, "Crisis on Naboo" happened some time after another episode, "[[Darkness on Umbara]]." Since {{FactFile2014|7|HEA 1-2|Z-95 Headhunter}} places "Darkness on Umbara" in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it can be concluded that "Crisis on Naboo" occurred around the same year. Using simple math, it can be deduced that Naboo joined the Republic in or around 868 BBY.</ref>
